questions.stem: Pointing to a photograph, Meena said, 'He is the son of my father's only son.' How is the person in the photograph related to Meena?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Meena's father's only son = Meena's brother. The person in the photo is the son of Meena's brother = Meena's nephew. Step chain: My father → only son = my brother → his son = my nephew.

questions.stem: A is B's sister. B's mother is C's mother. D is C's father. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: B is correct. B's mother = C's mother → B and C are siblings. A is B's sister → A, B, C are all siblings. D is C's father → D is also A's and B's father. Therefore A is D's daughter.

questions.stem: P's mother is Q's mother's daughter. How is Q related to P?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Q's mother's daughter = Q's sister. P's mother = Q's sister. So Q's sister is P's mother → Q is the sibling of P's mother → Q is P's maternal aunt.

questions.stem: Introducing a woman, a man says, 'She is the only daughter of my father's wife.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: B is correct. My father's wife = my mother. Mother's only daughter = the man's sister. The phrasing is designed to mislead — 'my father's wife' is simply the man's mother.

questions.stem: P is the brother of Q. R is the mother of P. S is the husband of R. T is the daughter of S. How is T related to Q?
questions.explanation: C is correct. R = mother of P; Q is P's brother so R = mother of Q also. S = R's husband = father of P and Q. T = S's daughter = child of P and Q's parents. So T, P, and Q are all siblings. T is Q's sister.

questions.stem: A man walking with a child tells someone: 'She is my mother's only son's daughter.' How is the child related to the man?
questions.explanation: D is correct. 'My mother's only son' = the man himself. 'His daughter' = the man's daughter. The roundabout phrasing is the key trap; it simply resolves to 'my daughter'.

questions.stem: In a family, A is the husband of D. B is the daughter of A. C is the brother of A. E is the son of D. Who is B's uncle?
questions.explanation: C is correct. A and D are married. B and E are children (B = daughter, E = son). C = A's brother. B's uncle = B's father's brother = A's brother = C.

questions.stem: Looking at a portrait, Anita said, 'His mother's only daughter is my mother.' Who is Anita to the person in the portrait?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Portrait man's mother's only daughter = portrait man's sister. This sister is Anita's mother. So portrait man's sister = Anita's mother → portrait man = Anita's maternal uncle → Anita = his niece.

questions.stem: M is the son of N. P is the father of Q. Q is the sister of N. How is M related to P?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Q is N's sister → they share the same parents. P is Q's father → P is also N's father. M is N's son. Chain: P → N → M. P is M's grandfather, so M is P's grandson.

questions.stem: Six people — A, B, C, D, E, F — live together. F is the husband of E. D is the only son of F. B and C are daughters of E. A is the brother of D's mother's husband. How is A related to F?
questions.explanation: C is correct. D's mother = E (wife of F). D's mother's husband = E's husband = F. A is the brother of F. Unpack the chain: 'A is the brother of [D's mother's husband]' = 'A is the brother of F'. A and F are brothers.
